models.summary: A Spanish conversation partner for TouchLanguage Talk that runs on your device, with no network.
models.description: Google's Gemma 4 E2B, unchanged except for compression so it fits on an iPhone. Nothing in the weights is specific to Spanish: the tutoring comes from the TouchLanguage tutor prompt it receives every turn, which asks for short, level-appropriate replies that follow what you said and ask one question at a time. At the intermediate level it says a mistake back the right way instead of pointing it out, and it explains grammar only when you ask. Like any small model, it can miss a detail from earlier in a long conversation.

sample.text: Hola, quiero practicar español mientras preparo una cena.
¡Qué bien! ¿Qué vas a cocinar esta noche?
Voy a cocinar pasta con tomates. ¿Qué debo hacer primero?
Primero, calienta el agua para la pasta. ¿Necesitas ayuda con algún ingrediente?
